verdict.rationale: The evidence documents card issuing, card transaction retrieval APIs, spend controls, webhooks and statement exports. None of it shows receipts being automatically captured or transactions being coded or categorized when a card is used. Transaction retrieval and webhooks are only developer building blocks from which such a feature could be built, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry
